rule_gaps: Blivakker's whole feed lands in Beauty: its 'Smykker & tilbehør > Smykker' / 'Armbånd' / 'Øredobber' crumbs never reach Jewelry (12 rows here), and its 'Drikkeflasker' / 'Outlet Accessories' rows have no readable crumb at all — CAT_RULES needs the smykker/armbånd/øredobb/halssmykke vocabulary, and Blivakker must not keep a Beauty floor
home fragrance is unmapped: 'Duftlys' (scented candle), 'Duftpinner' (reed diffuser) and 'Romspray' resolve to Beauty instead of Home — 13 rows across Skandinavisk, Teatro Fragranze and Trudon
'Sminkebord' (dressing table) matches the sminke=makeup vocabulary and pulls furniture into Beauty; the Møbler/Bord crumb should win
Kicks appends the variant label to a name that already ends in it ('… 50 ml 50 ml', '… 403 403') on 32 of the 34 Kicks-sourced rows in this shard — a crawler-side dedupe would fix all of them at once

facetrules.js derives Beauty type from the last word rather than the breadcrumb: 'Cream'→Moisturisers on a styling wax and a contour stick, 'Mousse'→Hair care on two self-tans, 'Mask'→Masks on TIRTIR cushion foundations and a Wella colour mask, 'Primer'→Face makeup on a lash primer; makeup brushes split between Face makeup and Tools
notes: Data itself is healthy — prices, EANs and brands are almost all sane; the damage is systematic rather than per-product: 35 rows are not beauty products at all (jewellery, home fragrance, dressing tables, dog gear, model paint), one row is a shop display rack that should be demoted, and 153 of 294 rows (52%) still have no image because their shops are only sampled.
